title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Sandwiches
subtitle: A dozen eggs and cheese baked between two layers of slider rolls.
description: Eggs baked on a sheet pan, cut into squares, and layered on toasted buns with sausage and cheese. Ten sandwiches without flipping eggs one at a time.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 350°F. Slice the connected roll block horizontally into tops and bottoms without separating individual rolls.

steps.title: Bake the egg sheet
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper. Pour into a parchment-lined quarter sheet pan to roughly slider dimensions. Bake until just set—don't overbake or eggs turn rubbery.

steps.title: Trim and assemble
steps.instruction: Trim egg sheet to fit the roll block. Place bottom halves on a lined sheet pan, add sausage, egg sheet, cheese, and top halves. Press gently to align seams.

steps.title: Final bake
steps.instruction: Brush tops with melted butter and optional everything seasoning. Bake until cheese melts and tops turn lightly golden.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes, then cut along roll seams with a sharp knife. Serve warm from the pan or transfer to a baking dish for the line.

stationWorkflow: Measure the roll block before baking the egg sheet—trim once, not twice, for clean sandwich edges.
Use parchment to lift the egg sheet out of the quarter pan for easier trimming and placement.
Cut seams with a long serrated knife in one pass per row to avoid squashing the stacks.
cleanupNotes: Discard parchment with baked-on egg residue instead of scraping—saves time on busy mornings.
Wipe the sheet pan while warm with a damp towel before butter glaze hardens on the rim.
leftovers: Wrap sandwiches individually in foil and reheat at 325°F for 10 minutes until cheese remelts.
Split leftovers and griddle cut-side down for a crisp second-day version with fresh hot sauce.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bread/crust/wrapper alternative. Make your own blend from individually confirmed gluten-free spices, or use a certified gluten-free seasoning packet.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use oat, almond, or soy milk (check tree-nut/soy status of the substitute). Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative. Use a plant-based butter/margarine.

adaptable.label: Pork-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Swap in chicken or turkey sausage.
